[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Dana Whitfield, Controller at Kestrel Manufacturing. Precise and numbers-fluent; expects the same back. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes
Subject: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Gabriel,

I’m pulling the numbers for Thursday’s board meeting and the gross margin on the 3Q close is sitting at 28.4%, which is about 1.2 points below what we projected. I need to be able to explain the driver before I put this in front of the board.

Can you confirm whether the variance is from the material cost spike in late September or if there’s something in the freight side I’m not accounting for? If you have a split by line, that would help. I need this by Wednesday COB so I can draft the commentary.

Thanks,
Dana

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Margin number for Thursday board — need clarity before then

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the heads-up. I dug into the 3Q close and can confirm the variance is almost entirely on the material cost side — the late-September spike accounts for roughly 1.1 of the 1.2 points. Freight is tracking close to projection, within a few basis points, so nothing material there.

I’ve attached a split by product line showing the material impact concentrated in two SKUs where the supplier surcharge landed in the last week of September. That should give you what you need for the commentary. If you’d like, I can walk through the numbers with you tomorrow morning before you finalize.

Happy to help with any follow-up.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
